name: Great Mending
description: The event that heals Dominaria's fractures and strips planeswalkers of godlike power.

timeline.summary: Jared likely loses his immortality in the Great Mending.
timeline.quote: losing his immortality and godlike powers

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Great Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska's final sacrifice closes the last rift, catalyzing the Great Mending; planeswalkers become mortal mages.
timeline.quote: Jeska’s final sacrifice closed the last rift, catalyzing the multiversal Great Mending .

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "The Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the rift at the heart of Otaria, consuming her entirely and unleashing the Great Mending.

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending restructures the Multiverse; pre-Mending planeswalkers lose their powers, beginning the Mending Era.

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending closes planar portals and weakens planeswalkers' ability to bring others and summon creatures.
timeline.quote: The Great Mending closed existing planar portals, weakened planeswalkers' ability to bring others with them while planeswalking, and the ability to summon creatures from other planes.

citation.text: "Plane", section "Mending Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending heals Dominaria's fractures and planeswalkers lose their immortality.
timeline.quote: The Great Mending takes place: all remaining fractures heal

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the cycle, and Oona fears she may be affected by the Great Aurora.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted in 4520 after the Great Mending

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending healed the Multiverse and unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.
timeline.quote: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.

citation.text: Fraying Omnipotence (Core Set 2019, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle, making Oona fear she might be affected.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted over forty years ago by the Great Mending

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Just before execution Sahr is pulled thousands of years forward, sees Sarpadia's ruin, and returns with the Great Mending.
timeline.quote: Pulled thousands of years forward just before his execution

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the last major rift in Otaria, healing all remaining fractures across Dominaria and the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: The Great Mending began when Jeska sealed the last major rift in Otaria in 4500 AR .

citation.text: "Great Mending", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers lose immortality and godlike powers and existing planar travel tech stops working.
timeline.quote: Planeswalkers lost their immortality and godlike powers and much of their additional magic power.

citation.text: "Great Mending", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending of 4500 AR repairs Dominaria's time rifts and drastically weakens planeswalkers, beginning the Mending Era.
timeline.quote: the repair of Dominaria's time rifts drastically weakened planeswalkers throughout the Multiverse

citation.text: "Mending Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
